p.s: Travelling is one of most exciting things to do on a holiday.
When I have the time, I like to travell alot.
I have visited India, Egipt, and Morocco.
There are some difficulties that you might incounter during a vacation.
For that reasoun i think that its best to be in a group or to have a toure guide.
First, you may have difficulties finding the right place that you want to be in.
For example, you might want to visit a cetain mall or a mounten but you can not find where it is.
More often, you may get lost in the new country.
A toure guide will organize your trip and make your vacation more enjoyable.
Second, you may have difficulties with a forigne language or culture.
For example, a cetain sign in one culture may be offinsive in an other culture.
Also, a certain word in one culture maybe offinsive in an other.
Having a torue guide will avoid you thies proplems and will help you with the language and the culture.
Third, you maybe defraud by other people in a new country or someone may steal your things.
For example, I went two years ago to Morocco.
While i was there someone tried to steal my bag and passport.
Luckly he failed to do so.
Beeing in a group and having a toure guide will be most benefical in that case.
The toure guide will avoid places where you might get hurt in, Also, will make sure that you stay in the most comfetable places.
In conclusion, i think that having a tour guide is very important.
First, a toure guide will help to go wherever you want in the most comfetable ways.
Second, a tour guide will help you deal with the new culture and language.
Third, a tour guide will keep you save in any case.
